screenSummary.playArea: A star-filled planetarium view from Berea shows the Sun, Mercury, the horizon, and their angular separation.
screenSummary.controlArea: View mode can hold the sky, Sun, or Mercury steady. Date controls animate time, step by one day, or jump between greatest elongations.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Choose a view mode, then change the date or play time to compare each body's motion against the stars.

screenSummary.playArea: A top-down ecliptic view shows the Sun, Mercury, Earth, their orbit paths, and the elongation measured at Earth.
screenSummary.controlArea: Date controls set local mean solar time. Buttons animate time, step by one day, or jump between greatest elongations.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Change the date or play time to connect the orbital geometry with Mercury's observed elongation.
